violations.text: Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from (below) raw ready-to-eat food during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the bar dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Service call placed. Barware must be sanitized using the kitchen dishwasher (tested at proper concentration), or the 3-bay sink manually set up with proper chlorine concentration, until bar dishwasher is serviced and reaching proper chlorine concentration. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration of the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink in the kitchen was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 - 400 ppm. Service call placed. Quat sanitizer is used to sanitize food contact surfaces. Sanitizer buckets must be manually set-up with chlorine (to proper concentration) until the 3-bay sink is serviced and dispensing proper concentration of quaternary ammonium. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Utensils observed displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwashers. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
The door to one of the restrooms is not self-closing. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
The receptacles in the restrooms are lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwashers. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2025
